headline: PR #255 is OPEN for claude/business-state-issues-42vql1 — the 36-commit branch everything was stacking on is finally in review. Gated properly for the first time: green on typecheck, lint, verify-tokens, check-contrast, check-figma-drift --ci, pnpm test (139 files, 1803 passed), check:size, smoke:consumer, build-storybook, and the five gates the PR template requires — including check-source-canon and check-binding-drift, which #210 recorded as red on main. Two gates needed an honest call rather than a fix: check:size needed a budget re-baseline (manifest 45.43 -> 47.83 kB gzipped because componentSpecs went 120 -> 139 components; 47 -> 55 kB, approved by Adrian, not taken unilaterally), and check-tier-bypass is still red at 16 vs 17 on main — pre-existing, #186/#242, not a CI-PR gate. /code-review ran first as CLAUDE.md mandates and raised four findings; three were verified against the tree and fixed in 570cdc1, the fourth went to Adrian. #235 CLOSED with the count reconciled. #252 ANSWERED: stale Figma file, not a build-figma-model.mjs bug. #236 answered in the negative and measured: use_figma truncates at 20 KB, so an agent can never retrieve a 339-variable snapshot intact.
